decision: Retain the article's three river-mouth coordinates as source-reported locality anchors only. They are not fish-sampling station coordinates, occurrence points, or river boundary geometry.

source.title: Environmental and habitat variables influencing the fish assemblages in the three tropical river systems in Bataan Peninsula, Luzon Island, Philippines
source.citation: Corpuz, M. N. C., Nacorda, H. M. E., Casal, C. M. E., Faustino-Eslava, D. V., Jaranilla-Sanchez, P. A., & Espaldon, M. V. O. (2025). AACL Bioflux, 18(4), 1650-1662.
source.licenseEvidence: The publisher PDF states that the article is open access under a Creative Commons Attribution License. This review records coordinates as factual source data and does not reproduce article figures or prose.

studyDesign.stationPositionMethod: The methods state that geographic position and elevation were recorded at each sampling station using a GPS device.
studyDesign.publishedStationCoordinates: No per-station coordinate list or station-coordinate table is provided in the reviewed article. River-level fish presence in Table 2 cannot be assigned to individual stations or stream sections.

coordinateHandling.conversion: Decimal degree values are arithmetic conversions from the article's printed degrees-minutes-seconds coordinates, rounded to six decimal places.
coordinateHandling.datumOrCrs: Not specified in the article; do not label the values WGS 84 or another CRS.
limitations: The article labels these positions as river mouths; they do not describe the extent or boundary of any river.
The mouth coordinates must not be substituted for the 27 sampling station positions.
No fish row, station, reach, or stream section can be spatially assigned from these mouth coordinates alone.

relatedEvidence.tableMeaning: Source-reported presence/absence by river only; not a station-level detection matrix.

nextStep: If station-level spatial evidence is needed, seek a lawful author or institutional supplement containing station coordinates and its datum/CRS. Until then, retain only the article's river-mouth anchors and keep all fish detections at the source's river-level granularity.
